title: Thth
script:
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- CONFIG
local BRIGHTNESS = 3
local FOG_END = 100000
local FOG_START = 0

-- Função que aplica tudo
local function applyVisual()
    Lighting.Brightness = BRIGHTNESS
    Lighting.ClockTime = 12
    Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
    Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)

    Lighting.FogStart = FOG_START
    Lighting.FogEnd = FOG_END

    -- remover efeitos chatos
    for _, v in pairs(Lighting:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("Atmosphere") or v:IsA("BloomEffect") or v:IsA("BlurEffect") then
            v:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

-- Aplica uma vez quando rodar
applyVisual()

-- Reaplica quando o personagem spawnar
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(1) -- espera carregar certinho
    applyVisual()
end)
